title: Lee Theatre

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified Hong Kong Lands Department bare-earth elevation at the corner entrance sidewalk.

mapIdentity.provider: Survey and Mapping Office 1:1000 sheet 11-SW-15B, editions 1975 and 1989.
mapIdentity.scope: The near-identical original 1975 and 1989 Hong Kong Lands Department sheets establish a twelve-vertex theatre envelope and southeast chamfered entry. The story coordinates lie just west of the measured footprint. A new anchor derived from the historical survey secures the correct parcel.

note: Government heritage records place the Lee Theatre on this site as a major dual opera and cinematic venue. Written architecture and period newspaper reporting describe the marble-faced Beaux-Arts street exterior, flanking columns and small domed entry tower, and a broad dome at the auditorium.
